description: This file defines the Bootstrap modal component (version 3.3.7), including the Modal class, its methods, and jQuery plugin integration for modal dialogs.

classes.name: Modal
classes.description: A class managing modal dialog behavior, including show, hide, backdrop handling, focus enforcement, and transition effects.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the modal dialog with transition effects.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the modal dialog with transition effects.

methods.name: enforceFocus
methods.description: Ensures focus stays within the modal when open.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Handles ESC key to close modal if enabled.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Handles window resize events to adjust modal positioning.

methods.name: hideModal
methods.description: Completes the hide process and removes backdrop.

methods.name: backdrop
methods.description: Creates or removes the backdrop element with transition effects.

methods.name: checkScrollbar
methods.description: Checks if scrollbar is present and measures its width.

methods.name: setScrollbar
methods.description: Adjusts body padding to account for scrollbar.

methods.name: resetScrollbar
methods.description: Resets body padding after modal close.
